name: Doggo 🐾
tagline: One breed-aware dog training idea in your inbox each morning
description: Tell it about your particular dog - breed, age, quirks - and every morning it sends a single training, enrichment or calming exercise matched to that animal. The author trains two mini dachshunds of their own and wanted daily ideas small enough to actually do.
author: dannybuck
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
